intro-1-2: If you are listening to this, the shop is yours, and I am not there to explain it.
intro-2-1: For fifteen years you asked me how my day had been.
intro-2-2: For fifteen years I told you it was fine.
intro-3-1: I made toys. That part was true.
intro-3-2: I made them very well. That was the problem.
intro-4-1: The ones I sold did not stay sold.
intro-4-2: That is all I am going to say about it tonight. You will find the rest yourself, and I would rather you did.
intro-5-1: There is a book under the till. Do not open it on the first night.
intro-5-2: Open it when you have had enough of me being careful.
intro-6-1: There are four in the back room that I never sold. Cogsworth. Chime. Marabelle. Jax.
intro-6-2: They are the only ones I ever made right.
intro-7-1: Wind them. Every night, before six.
intro-7-2: And whatever else comes to that door — and something will — do not open it.
intro-7-3: I am sorry. You do not know what for yet, and that is the last easy night you get.
terms-1: Ouissy. Stop. Before you touch anything, listen.
terms-2: The shutters are down. They will not go up again until six. That is not me being dramatic, it is a timer, and I set it a long time ago.
terms-3: Six nights. That is what I am asking for. Six, and then everything.
terms-4: I have left the whole of it in here — on the tapes, on the shelves, in the book under the till. It is all yours. But I am not handing the worst thing I ever did to somebody who might not be here on Saturday.
terms-5: So get through them. All six. And try very hard not to let anything reach you, because I would like you to hear the end of this from me and not work it out from the mess.
terms-6: You have been braver than me for fifteen years. One more week.
tape1-01: One of six. You said yes, so here is the first thing.
tape1-02: The kettle is behind the till. It takes a while. Everything in here does.
tape1-03: I want you to look at the shop tonight and nothing else. Learn where things are.
tape1-04: The four in the back are not stock. I never sold those.
tape1-05: Tonight that is all you need to know about them.
tape1-06: They walk. It is not a fault. I built them to, and by Thursday you will be glad of it.
tape1-07: The monitor draws power while it is up. So does a shut door. That is the whole of the job.
tape1-08: There is more meter than there is night. You will be fine.
tape1-09: I used to sit in that chair until four in the morning telling myself I was working.
tape1-10: Nothing in this shop wants to hurt you. I want to say that on the first night, while it is still true.
tape1-11: Shut the door if one gets close. It costs you a little. It costs you less than the other thing.
tape1-12: You are better at this than I was. I mean that.
tape1-13: The brass plate on the front of that desk. I had it made in March, and I never worked out how to tell you what it was for.
tape1-14: Nearly six. Whatever you can hear out there, it stops at six.
tape1-15: One down. Go home. Sleep. Come back tonight.
tape2-01: You came back. I have been sitting here all day not knowing whether you would.
tape2-02: Two of six. Tonight I tell you what the four of them are.
tape2-03: The soldier keeps time. He has never once been late.
tape2-04: I admired that in somebody else first.
tape2-05: The owl goes through the ceiling because that is how a roof works. It is not being clever. The hatch stops it and nothing else does.
tape2-06: The ballerina stops when she is looked at. Everybody does.
tape2-07: Do not look at her all night, though. You will lose the meter and she will still be there.
tape2-08: And the box. The box does not leave a room while there is anybody in it.
tape2-09: He knocks instead. Every knock is meter. He knows that.
tape2-10: You have probably worked out the pattern by now.
tape2-11: Timekeeping. A roof. Dancing when she thinks nobody can see. And never once walking out of a room I was in.
tape2-12: I made four toys, Ouissy. I only ever had one idea, and it was you.
tape2-13: Wind them if you get the chance. There is a key in the back of each one.
tape3-01: Halfway. This is the night I have been dreading, so I am going to get it over with.
tape3-02: There is a book under the till. I would rather you did not. You will, and you should.
tape3-03: Four hundred and eleven of them went out of this shop.
tape3-04: Every one to a real address. Every one to somebody who was pleased to get it.
tape3-05: They were bought as presents. That part is true.
tape3-06: The tag on the bottom of each one has this shop on it.
tape3-07: So they know the way back. I did that on purpose and I am not going to pretend otherwise.
tape3-08: Some of them have started using it.
tape3-09: If a parcel arrives that nobody sent, that is not a delivery. Do not open the door for it.
tape3-10: Watching one does nothing. They were not built for you and they do not care whether you are there.
tape3-11: A shut door holds them. They try the handle for a while and then they go.
tape3-12: I am telling you this badly. I have started this tape four times.
tape3-13: You are still here. That is the part I keep not expecting.
tape4-01: All right. The thing I have been walking around for three nights.
tape4-02: A toy in a house sees the house. All of it. Every night, for years.
tape4-03: It sees who comes. It sees what gets said when the door is shut.
tape4-04: And a toy that finds its own way back to the shop it came from brings all of that with it.
tape4-05: That is what I did. That is the whole of it.
tape4-06: Money came into our house and you never asked, and I let you not ask, every week, for fifteen years.
tape4-07: You are standing in the middle of it now.
tape4-08: I am sorry. That is not enough and I know it is not enough.
tape4-09: I am not going to ask you to forgive any of it. I would like you to understand it, which is different.
tape4-10: The four in the back are the only ones I ever made for nothing.
tape4-11: No tag. No address. Nothing on the bottom of them at all.
tape4-12: Keep them wound tonight. I will explain tomorrow.
tape5-01: Five. Tonight is the one I actually needed you to reach.
tape5-02: They have started coming back on their own. I did not call them. Nobody called them.
tape5-03: There is nothing left to send them anywhere, so they are doing the only thing they know.
tape5-04: Keep the four of them wound tonight. All four. Do not ask me why yet.
tape5-05: There is a key in the back of each one and it takes about a second.
tape5-06: And if one of them gets to the door before you do — let it. Do not shut it. Let it.
tape5-07: I know how that sounds. Let it.
tape5-08: They were never for the shop, Ouissy.
tape5-09: They were for you. In case I was not there.
tape5-10: I built the whole four of them out of you and I never once said so out loud.
tape5-11: Fifteen years of watching you and the best thing I ever made with it was four toys in a back room.
tape5-13: Five down. One more, and then I stop asking you for anything.
tape6-01: Six. Last one. I made this tape in the morning, which I never do.
tape6-02: You will have worked out by now what I was. I would like to say I was more than that.
tape6-03: I was not. A man is the sum of what he actually did.
tape6-04: But I was also a man who made four things that will stand at a door for you, and that is on the list too.
tape6-05: The shutters go up at six on their own. Every morning. They always have.
tape6-06: You have done the six nights. You do not owe this shop anything else.
tape6-07: When it is light you can lock the place and never come back. That is a real choice and I want you to have it.
tape6-08: The book, the shelves, the four in the back. Sell it, burn it, leave it. Any of those is fine.
tape6-09: I am not going to be here to mind.
tape6-10: But if you wind her one more time before you go, she will dance.
tape6-11: She only ever did it when she thought nobody was watching. So did you.
tape6-12: And I would like somebody to see it.
tape6-13: Thank you for the six nights. Thank you for the fifteen years.
when-firstDoor: That is the sound I built into it. You should be able to hear it from the desk.
when-firstCam: The tube takes a moment. It always did.
when-firstWind: There. That is all it is. A key and about a second.
when-firstParcel: That is not one of mine coming down the hall. Shut the door.
when-lowPower: If the meter goes, sit still. Six o'clock has beaten the dark before now.
reveal-1: You never once asked me for a key. I have thought about that a great deal, lately.
reveal-2: You will have worked out what they are. I made four toys and I only ever had the one idea.
reveal-3: I did not tick those. I was not here. Whatever is doing it is doing it on its own.
reveal-4: I know what that book is. I know exactly what it looks like from where you are standing. I am not going to tell you it was anything else.
reveal-5: The first fifteen years I was learning you so I could sell what I learned. The last two I was learning you so I could leave something behind that knew how to stand in front of you.
reveal-6: That is the last of it. There is nothing after this one. Thank you for the six nights.
caught-first: That was my fault. I built the thing that did that. Go again — the tape will keep.
caught-later: Again. I am still here at the end of it.
